whenToUse: One sentence fits several uses, such as design, documents, and presentations.
Large headings on an introduction page.
The words are of similar length.
whenNotToUse: Information people must read in the changing word.
It moves for more than 5 seconds with no way to stop it.
accessibility: Screen readers hear all the words at once and aren't told about each change.
A pause button stops the motion (WCAG 2.2.2).
With reduced motion, it stays on the first word and the button is hidden.
The pause button announces its state with aria-pressed.
